description: Thousand Islands: an archipelago of small wooded islands in a wide lake fed from the north edge, with badwater springs on several islands; the start island is cramped, so the Deep Frontier sites spread across the islands behind bridges, with Deep Ore Veins on Neighbour Isle (north-east of the start) and the north-east highland, Deep Ore Sources on the south-east and south-west isles, the launch pad on South Isle and no flat ground anywhere for the 20x15 reactor.

unmet.reason: The start island (548 dry cells, x 81-104, y 83-110) is the only land within route 60 that needs no bridge: it holds 172 trees (min 200). Every other island lies across open water (the nearest is 3 water cells away), so the count cannot be reached without bridging.
The start island is the only land within route 60 that needs no bridge: it has 149 dry, flat, free cells within 4 of clean water (min 150).
No dry flat 20x15 footprint exists at any level: the largest flat dry rectangles are 20x11 (76, 245, 16) and 15x16 (216, 217, 6).

The map holds 9 disjoint flat 12x10 footprints in all, one of them on the start island. The two Deep Mines need two of the tree-free vein spots (Neighbour Isle, the north-east isle, the north-east highland; the fourth lies inside the start island's only 12x10 footprint) and take three footprints (two on the highland) or, on the north-east isle, still leave one 12x11 short; the launch pad, Water Treatment Plant, Uranium Processing Plant, Radioactive Waste Refinery, Cryogenic Liquefaction Plant and Mission Control take the remaining six, so no 12x10 footprint is left for the Steel Mill.
